mentions.name: SG-P27
mentions.description: A music control system that uses Wii balance boards as input devices. It orchestrates a set of processes to talk to bluetoothd, automatically connect to the boards, match each board to its /dev/input/event* device, and read those devices, sending the data onward over OSC. A dashboard built with a custom TUI library for Deno is planned to monitor the state of all the pieces.
mentions.problem: Every step of talking to bluetoothd, auto-connecting boards, matching /dev/input/event* devices, and streaming over OSC has proven about ten times harder than expected, so after months of work the project is still at the process-orchestration stage rather than actually making music.
